name: Le Thanh Phong — Full-Stack Software Engineer Resume

sections.headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer
sections.text: Full-stack engineer with 5+ years of experience building scalable, AI-driven web platforms, microservice architectures, and cloud-native deployments. Focused on Next.js/React frontends, Node.js/FastAPI backends, and shipping AI agent products that measurably improve lead capture and conversion.

highlights: Built end-to-end AI sales and enrollment agents that increased qualified lead capture by 60-90% and reduced manual lead handling by ~80%.
Implemented GraphQL and REST APIs with schema versioning and contract tests to keep frontend and backend aligned during rapid iterations.
Improved page performance and TTFB via SSR/SSG and server-side caching, raising organic traffic and reducing bounce rate.
Introduced Docker-based CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) and containerized deployments, shortening release lead time and enabling safe rollbacks.
Developed and maintained end-to-end web applications using Vue.js, Node.js, and AWS services.
Redesigned legacy modules into microservices, improving scalability and deployment flexibility.
Implemented automated testing and CI/CD pipelines to streamline release processes.
Transitioned from academic learning to real-world corporate IT support environment.
Developed customer service and technical support skills in a professional setting.
